findings.decompiled: stor1 is fixed array of bytes at storage 1 ... stor7 is fixed array of uint256 at storage 7 / _365 = sha3(nextValidatorId, 258) / stor1[_365] = 2 * _370 + 1 / stor4[_365] = address(_355) / stor5[_365] = t
findings.issue: Members 1-7 of the struct mapping stor258 (pubkey, the two signatures, withdrawVaultAddress, operatorId, depositBlock, withdrawnBlock) are declared as seven fixed arrays at slots 1-7 (which are really Initializable's __gap) and written as stor1[_365]..stor7[_365] with _365 = sha3(k, 258); the same slots are elsewhere printed as stor258[k].field_256 etc. The slot arithmetic agrees (1 + _365), but the names say 'array at slot 1 indexed by a hash'.
findings.rule: A slot sha3(k, S) + m with m smaller than the struct size of the mapping at S is member m of S[k]; never type stor[m + h] with h a keccak result as a fixed array at slot m.

findings.source: slot 251: uint16 inputKeyCountLimit (+0), uint64 maxNonTerminalKeyPerOperator (+2), IStaderConfig staderConfig (+10); initialize sets staderConfig, inputKeyCountLimit = 30, maxNonTerminalKeyPerOperator = 50
findings.issue: P15: the packed slot is not split in def storage, so staderConfig reads as address(stor251 >> 80) in 41 lines (once as address(stor251.field_80)), and initialize's three field stores are one whole-slot expression with the constant 3276830 = 50 << 16 | 30.
findings.rule: When every access to a slot uses disjoint bit ranges (here [0,16), [16,80), [80,240)), declare one field per range and print shifted/masked reads and masked writes as field reads and field stores; split a whole-slot store into one store per range that changes.

findings.source: PermissionlessNodeRegistry.sol:221 uint256 validatorId = validatorIdByPubkey[_readyToDepositPubkey[i]]; onlyInitializedValidator(validatorId) -> revert UNEXPECTED_STATUS()
findings.issue: The bytes-keyed mapping validatorIdByPubkey loses its name and key (a hash of raw memory), and the custom errors are raw-memory reverts, because _46 - mem[64] and _52 - mem[64] (no store to slot 64 in between) are not reduced to 0.
findings.rule: Prove mem[64] >= 128 so stores at mem[64] + k do not alias slot 64, copy-propagate _x = mem[64]; then sha3 over 'pubkey bytes ++ 259' is stor259[pubkey] and 'revert memory from P len 4' after 'mem[P] = sel' is 'revert with sel'.

findings.decompiled: if _param2: <element 0 initialised> if _param2 != 1: <element 1 initialised> ... while idx - 1: <element initialised> ... ; if 0 >= s: return Array(...) / <element 0 encoded> / while True: ...
findings.source: PermissionlessNodeRegistry.sol:549 Validator[] memory validators = new Validator[](_pageSize); :562 return validators;
findings.issue: The implicit initialisation loop of new Validator[](n) is printed with its first two iterations peeled before a 'while idx - 1' test (P3), and the ABI encoding of the returned struct array peels element 0 and continues as 'while True' whose exit carries the return.
findings.rule: Re-roll peeled iterations that repeat the loop body with the induction variable at its initial values (P3), and turn 'while True: if c: <tail ending in return>' into 'while not c' followed by the tail.

notes: All 61 ABI functions compared; the eight long ones (addValidatorKeysWithUtilizeSD 507 lines, addValidatorKeys 471, getAllActiveValidators 322, getValidatorsByOperator 257, markValidatorReadyToDeposit 228, withdrawnValidators 165, onboardNodeOperator 159, getOperatorTotalNonTerminalKeys 112) by structure (calls, storage writes, events, reverts, loops); the getters, setters, role functions and initialize read in full. No semantic error found: e.g. isActiveValidator (status == DEPOSITED) as 'if mem[_201] != 4', onlyInitializedValidator's two reverts, the bytes storage stores with old-tail clearing (copy lines), initialize's merged slot-251 store and the AccessControl message built by toHexString (the role 0 loop folded to '0' digits) are exact. Loops: 10 source loops, all readable whiles: toHexString (6 inlined copies in grantRole/revokeRole/updateStaderConfig), getAllNodeELVaultAddress, withdrawnValidators, getOperatorTotalNonTerminalKeys (3 copies), the three loops of markValidatorReadyToDeposit, getAllActiveValidators, getValidatorsByOperator, and _addValidatorKeys' key loop (2 copies). The other 23 whiles are implicit: 2 rotated new Validator[] initialisations and 21 ABI-encoding copies (P7, including 2 'while True'). P11: initializer's onlyInitializing check after 'if not stor0_8: stor0_8 = 1', the toHexString index checks. P18: Validator struct copies visible only as mem[_201 + k].
summary: Faithful on the paths checked, with every source loop a readable while; hard to read because the Validator struct's members appear as seven fake fixed arrays at slots 1-7, slot 251 is not split (staderConfig as address(stor251 >> 80)), and bytes-keyed mapping lookups and custom errors are left as raw memory.
